claims.text: NASA ordered Boeing's Starliner to return uncrewed because the spacecraft experienced five reaction-control system (RCS) thruster anomalies during its docking approach, and NASA determined that these thrusters could not be guaranteed safe for the deorbit burn as they could not be ground-tested in their flight condition [Source: ev-1].

This decision meant that astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams remained on the International Space Station until March 2025, resulting in a stay of roughly 9.5 months compared to a planned duration of approximately 8 days [Source: ev-1].
